decks.notes: The deck aims to quickly assemble a powerful equipment combo, utilizing Puresteel Paladin and Colossus Hammer to create a potent threat that can end the game in just a few swings. By tutoring for powerful equipment pieces like Colossus Hammer and Kaldra Compleat using Stoneforge Mystic and Urza's Saga, the deck can overwhelm opponents with huge creatures and evasion from Inkmoth Nexus. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Esper Sentinel and Solitude to control the game and protect the combo until it can be assembled.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to utilize aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Orcish Bowmasters along with disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Terminate to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The deck also includes graveyard interaction with cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Feign Death to further disrupt the opponent's game plan. Blood Moon is included as a disruptive element to hinder opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck focuses on early aggression and disruption to secure a quick victory in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

This UW Control deck focuses on utilizing a variety of counterspells, removal spells, and planeswalkers to control the game and outvalue the opponent. It also includes the companion Kaheera, the Orphanguard to provide additional synergy and flexibility. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan, protect its own threats, and eventually win through card advantage and powerful spells like Supreme Verdict and Teferi, Time Raveler. It also includes some creature removal in Prismatic Ending and Solitude, along with card advantage engines like Narset, Parter of Veils. The land base supports consistent mana production for the deck's spells.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a mix of powerful creatures and efficient removal spells. It aims to control the board early with cards like Tarmogoyf, Ragavan, and Lightning Bolt while disrupting the opponent's hand with spells like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize. The deck also utilizes planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and Wrenn and Six for additional value and card advantage. With a solid mana base and versatile spells like Terminate and Kolaghan's Command, this deck is designed to pressure the opponent and close out the game quickly.

This deck aims to assemble the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Tower, Urza's Power Plant) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. It utilizes powerful artifacts like Wurmcoil Engine and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger to control the game and overwhelm opponents. Expedition Map and Sylvan Scrying are used to search for the Tron lands, while Karn, the Great Creator provides additional utility with his ability to shut down opponents' artifacts. Overall, the deck focuses on ramping up quickly and deploying big threats to dominate the game.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the graveyard as a resource to quickly fill it with cards like Stinkweed Imp, Golgari Thug, and Tome Scour, while also generating value with cards like Prized Amalgam, Narcomoeba, and Creeping Chill. By dredging cards into the graveyard, the deck can trigger powerful effects like bringing back creatures, dealing damage to the opponent, and drawing cards. The deck aims to set up explosive turns by discarding cards with Cathartic Reunion and Thrilling Discovery, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with a flurry of creatures and spells from the graveyard.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of removal spells, planeswalkers, and powerful creatures. The goal is to slow down the opponent's game plan, while controlling the board and generating card advantage. The key to success lies in managing resources effectively, playing strategically, and utilizing the synergies between the different cards in the deck. By outlasting the opponent and setting up powerful combos with cards like The One Ring and Omnath, Locus of Creation, the deck aims to ultimately overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Death's Shadow, Ragavan, and Dragon's Rage Channeler to quickly lower the opponent's life total. It also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Spell Pierce to control the opponent's plays. The inclusion of cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration helps to generate card advantage and dig for key pieces. The deck also features a combo finish with Underworld Breach to recur spells from the graveyard. The companion Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional mana ramp and flexibility to the deck.

This control deck focuses on using a combination of efficient removal spells, planeswalkers, and powerful creatures to outvalue and control the opponent. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Leyline Binding and Teferi, Time Raveler, while generating value with Wrenn and Six and Nissa, Resurgent Animist. In addition, the deck includes powerful finishers like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines to close out the game. The mana base is carefully tuned to consistently cast the deck's powerful spells.

The key strategy of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly and efficiently deploy threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cheap, versatile spells like Lightning Bolt, Counterspell, and Force of Negation. The deck aims to apply pressure early in the game and close out the match before the opponent can stabilize. The inclusion of Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration helps to smooth out draws and filter through the deck, ensuring a consistent and proactive game plan. The deck's mana base is optimized for quick and consistent casting of spells to maintain momentum and pressure.

This deck focuses on controlling the board through a combination of removal spells and powerful planeswalkers. It also utilizes Leyline Binding to lock down key threats, while utilizing powerful creatures like Omnath and Elesh Norn to close out the game. The inclusion of Wrenn and Six provides additional value by recurring lands, while The One Ring serves as a versatile tool for various situations. By efficiently managing resources and controlling the pace of the game, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents in a 1 vs 1 setting.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Underworld Breach combo to repeatedly cast spells from the graveyard, generating infinite mana and card draw with Mishra's Bauble and Grinding Station. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mox Amber help to fuel the combo, while Teferi, Time Raveler provides protection and disruption. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Thassa's Oracle offer alternative win conditions. The deck also includes cards like Expressive Iteration and Unholy Heat for additional value and removal options, making it a powerful and versatile combo deck in the Modern format.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively burn your opponent's life total down to zero using a combination of direct damage spells and creatures with haste. By efficiently using cards like Lightning Bolt, Lava Spike, and Monastery Swiftspear, along with the ability to disrupt your opponent's lifegain strategies with cards like Skullcrack and Roiling Vortex, the deck aims to win the game before your opponent has a chance to stabilize. The deck's strategy is to overwhelm and outpace the opponent with relentless aggression and burn damage.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive, fast-paced play to overwhelm opponents quickly. Key cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief allow for early game pressure, while cards like Terminate and Lightning Bolt provide removal to maintain board control. The deck also utilizes cards like Thoughtseize and Seasoned Pyromancer for hand disruption and card advantage. By combining efficient creatures with powerful spells, this deck aims to put constant pressure on the opponent and close out the game before the opponent can establish their own game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying powerful Eldrazi creatures and disrupting the opponent with cards like Thought-Knot Seer and Karn, the Great Creator. The key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures while also controlling the board through disruption and removal spells. The deck also utilizes land cards like Urza's Tower, Mine, and Power Plant to generate mana efficiently and play high-impact spells. Additionally, the deck includes versatile cards like Chalice of the Void and Warping Wail to handle a variety of situations and threats.

The main concept of this Modern 1 vs 1 deck is to utilize the combo potential of Living End to bring powerful creatures back from the graveyard while disrupting the opponent's game plan. By cycling through cards like Street Wraith and Curator of Mysteries, as well as cascading into Living End with Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a board full of creatures like Striped Riverwinder and Oliphaunt. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Grief and Force of Negation helps to control the opponent's hand and spells, securing victory through a powerful combo finish.
